questions.stem: During a field test, a technician records the evidence: Quelle réponse applique correctement la règle de la leçon ?

options.text: Renaissance focused on humanism and antiquity

questions.explanation: The Renaissance was concerned with humanism and antiquity. The key is A, "Renaissance focused on humanism and antiquity". Option B ("Middle Ages focused on religion") is wrong: confuses Renaissance with medieval focus. Option C ("Enlightenment focused on reason") is wrong: confuses with later period. Option D ("Romanticism focused on emotion") is wrong: confuses with nineteenth century.
questions.hint: Think of the rebirth of antiquity.
